lines: > Local wiring support: for connector/pin/cable diagrams, prefer `wireviz -f ps <file.yml>` when WireViz and Graphviz are installed. This produces local PNG/SVG files without a remote renderer. On the configured Windows desktop, Graphviz is at `C:/Program Files/Graphviz/bin`; probe PATH before rendering. On other hosts, probe dependencies rather than assuming they exist. The Kroki fallback below sends the diagram source to its server when the URL is fetched.
